<function name="SetControlPointUpVector" parent="CNewParticleEffect" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the upward direction for given control point.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="cpID" type="number">The control point ID, 0 to 63.</arg>
		<arg name="upward" type="Vector">The upward direction for given control point</arg>
	</args>
</function>
